name: Thousand — Git-backed docs landing page by Thousand
description: A warm cream-and-yellow developer-tools landing page that alternates large serif-feeling headlines with dense, highly believable product mockups (file trees, comment threads, terminal output, spreadsheets). The rhythm alternates wide two-column feature rows with stacked bento cards, punctuated by full-width accent blocks (yellow "Decks and PDFs" band, near-black "no lock-in" section, and a huge yellow closing CTA). Highlights, dotted-underline annotations, and commit-style metadata give the page a distinctive "documents with editorial markup" character.
